# shell

```go
import "github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/shell"
```

Package shell is the drawer an app embeds: it owns the terminal size, tabs, focus, status, the overlay stack and the legend rule, and renders the app's panes into a declared layout. The app keeps everything that is its own.

## type [Action](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/shell/action.go#L16-L19>)

Action is one key for the legend, the dispatch and the palette. Run runs inside Shell.Update, so it must not change the app's copy of the shell \(the Update's result would overwrite it\): emit a message instead.

```go
    Entry() legend.Entry
    Run(ctx ActionContext) tea.Cmd
}
```

<a name="Config"></a>
## type [Config](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/shell/shell.go#L49-L71>)

Config is everything a Shell needs up front.

```go
type Config struct {
    Layout   layout.Node
    Tabs     []Tab // nil for a single-screen app
    Theme    theme.Resolved
    Title    string
    Subtitle string
    Version  string
    // Header replaces the default one-row header, one string per row. It runs
    // several times a frame, like Tab.Status.
    Header func(ctx Context, width int) []string
    // Can decides which legend entries survive. nil allows everything.
    Can func(Capability) bool
    // LegendLines is how many rows the legend may take: 1 for a compact
    // footer, 2 (the default, also for 0 or less) when the app has many keys.
    LegendLines int
    // Actions are active on every screen, before the tab's or SetActions's.
    Actions []Action
    // StatusTTL is how long the palette's errors and Copy's result stay on the
    // status row; 5s when zero. An app with its own banner clock passes that.
    StatusTTL time.Duration
    // Clipboard is what Copy writes to; nil means the system clipboard.
    Clipboard func(string) error
}
```

```go

```

Group puts the action in legend row group n: each group starts a new row while Config.LegendLines allows. Ungrouped actions are group 0.

<a name="Shell.Busy"></a>
### func \(Shell\) [Busy](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/shell/busy.go#L11>)

```go
func (s Shell) Busy(text string) (Shell, tea.Cmd)
```

Busy shows a spinner and text on the status row until Idle; a banner set meanwhile shows over it and busy returns when it expires. The command starts the spinner, and is nil when it is already spinning.

## type [Tab](<https://github.com/lucasassuncao/bezel/blob/main/shell/shell.go#L42-L46>)

Tab answers for one screen of the app: its name in the strip, the status text and the keys for where the user is. Status and Actions run several times a frame, so keep them cheap and free of side effects.

```go
type Tab interface {
    Name() string
    Status(ctx Context) string
    Actions(ctx Context) []Action
}
```
